summary: Introduces the set of DNS Security Extensions in one place and points to the main RFCs that define them. It states that using DNSSEC for origin authentication of DNS data is the best current practice. It does not update the earlier DNSSEC documents.

eli5.summary: DNSSEC puts a tamper-proof seal on internet address-book answers so you know they were not faked. This document is a map to all the pieces.
